dims_mm.note: Valve publishes one size: 298 x 117 x 49 mm.

slots.note: Single M.2 2230 slot. The 64 GB model ships an eMMC module in this slot instead of an NVMe SSD.

ports.note: DisplayPort 1.4 alt mode, up to 8K@60Hz or 4K@120Hz. pd_in_w is the Valve PD 3.0 power supply rating.
UHS-I; supports SD, SDXC and SDHC

screen.note: Optically bonded IPS LCD, 400 nits typical. The launch 512 GB model added anti-glare etched glass.

battery.note: Valve: 2-8 hours of gameplay. 45 W PD 3.0 USB-C power supply, 1.5 m cable.

controls.stick_note: 2 x full-size analog sticks with capacitive touch
controls.note: Trackpads are 32.5 mm square with haptic feedback and pressure sensitivity.

notes: Rows merged: 64 GB eMMC, 256 GB NVMe, and 512 GB NVMe share this hardware. Launch prices $399 / $529 / $649; Valve cut them to $349 / $399 / $449 when the OLED launched and phased the LCD models out. Valve opened orders on 2022-02-25; first shipments went out on 2022-02-28.
